articles.title: Banking rails are moving past the 'stablecoin winner' narrative: Sygnum
articles.snippet: Digital asset bank Sygnum says institutional clients want multiple tokenized cash instruments operating interchangeably on a single platform.

articles.title: Canton Network developer raises $355 million to bring Wall Street onchain

articles.title: Citi opens new route into private markets with tokenized share offering

articles.title: It's not SpaceX. Bitcoin ETF outflows may be an arbitrage story
articles.snippet: While some analysts argue investors are selling bitcoin to free up capital for anticipated IPOs such as SpaceX and Anthropic, Sygnum's Fabian Dori says market data points elsewhere.
